Ulterra Prime is a new skin elasticity enhancement technology developed by Ulterra SPT. It offers several advantages and key features:
Improved accuracy (improved visualization):
The 35% larger Full HD display allows doctors to view skin layers in real time with greater clarity and detail.

This allows doctors to precisely measure the location and depth at which microfocused ultrasound (MFU-V) energy is delivered to the fascial layer (SMAS), improving treatment outcomes and reducing the risk of skin damage.

Save time:
The processor (CPU) is up to 20% faster, enabling more stable and faster energy transfer. The procedure time is shorter than the previous model.

Enhanced comfort:
The energy delivery system and improved transducer provide more precise energy levels, reducing discomfort and pain during the procedure compared to previous models.

Effective results:

It helps tighten sagging skin and maintain elasticity. Helps improve wrinkles, nasolabial folds, and dark circles under the eyes.

It helps contour the face to make it look clearer and slimmer.

It stimulates the production of collagen and elastin deep within the skin, giving you firmer, younger-looking skin.

No break time:

This non-surgical, non-injectable, non-invasive facelift procedure is ideal for those who want smoother, younger-looking skin. You can put on makeup and return to your daily life immediately after the procedure.

Ulterra Prime and Ulterra SPT use the same core technology to deliver energy to the fascial layer (SMAS) and provide similar lifting effects. However, Ulterra Prime provides more precise and comfortable procedures for both the operator and the patient.

reviews.author: Narang “Runa 80” Kim
reviews.text:
Great Christmas atmosphere

Lotte Department Store's main branch is considered one of the 'proud photo meccas' in the Myeong-dong area for its colorful Christmas decorations at the end of every year.

A comprehensive summary of the Christmas atmosphere of recent years.

Characteristics of the Christmas atmosphere at the Lotte Department Store main branch

Christmas decorations
Not only the main department store building
Avenuel (Luxury Hall),
The entire Myeongdong area, including Young Plaza.
It is characterized by being formed by encompassing

Themes and Concepts New themes are introduced every year, and in recent years, concepts reminiscent of classic and glamorous European theaters or fairy tale worlds have been the main theme.
In 2024, with the theme of **"Wonderful Showtime"**, the atmosphere of the early 20th century Broadway theater was created.
In 2025, we will collaborate with a French illustrator with a message of comfort and support under the theme of **"Sweet Holidays"**.

Media façade and exterior wall decoration
Large media façade: A spectacular lighting show tailored to the theme through a large screen installed on the exterior wall of the main store.
(Generally operates in the evening, every 30 minutes)

Tens of thousands of colorful LED bulbs and neon signs surround the entire exterior wall of the main store, giving the streets of Myeongdong a classic, warm winter atmosphere. In particular, the lighting has been extended to the Avenuel (Luxury Hall), providing even more things to see.
Show window and photo zone

Moving Show Window (Diorama): The show window spanning approximately 100m from the new building to the main building is not just a simple display, but is decorated with moving decorations using dioramas, giving you the fun of watching a scene from a fairy tale.

Large photo zone: A themed photo zone in the form of a 3m high large character or ticket booth is set up in front of the main gate or in main areas, and is always crowded with visitors looking to take a photo.
The Christmas atmosphere usually starts lighting up in early November and lasts until the end of the year.

reviews.author: travel copper
reviews.text:
Most of the staff are friendly. I was able to shop comfortably as bottled water was provided as a service.

Let me briefly explain the brand called Prada. In 1913, brothers Mario Prada and Martino Prada started out as Fratelli Prada, a leather goods store opened in Milan, Italy. In the beginning, we sold leather goods, handbags and trunk bags imported from England. Mario believed that women should not run businesses, so the women in his family were not allowed to enter the store. However, his son was not interested in business, so his daughter Luisa Prada took over the family business and ran it for the next 20 years.

In 1978, the founder's granddaughter, Miuccia Prada, took over the business. Patrizio Bertelli, who started a leather goods business in his late teens, joined Miuccia's business and played a major role in stopping the import of British products and bringing about changes in the existing product style. In 1979, Bertelli's management acumen and Miuccia's design were combined to produce a backpack and tote bag set, which was sold in department stores and boutiques around the world.

In 1984, a line of black tote bags and shoes made of nylon fabric was introduced. At this time, we expanded our stores to Florence, Paris, Madrid, and New York. Prada grew significantly in 1985 when the ‘Prada Classic Handbag’ made of nylon fabric gained sensational popularity. In 1987, Miuccia and Bertelli got married, and Prada launched a women's ready-to-wear collection with an emphasis on long waistlines and narrow belts. Clean lines, elegantly styled fabrics and the most basic color choices have become the trademarks of Prada products. In addition to the outfit, narrow belts, elegant high-heeled shoes, and antique handbags also received praise.

reviews.author: NAMTAEK KIM
reviews.text:
On December 17, 1979, it opened as Lotte Shopping Center, located at 1 Sogong-dong, Jung-gu, Seoul, with 1 underground floor and 7 floors above ground.

After purchasing the land from the Korea Development Bank in 1983, construction was carried out to expand the Lotte Hotel's new building and the department store's main branch. The expanded space opened on January 28, 1988, and it was not until November 1, 1988 that the name was changed to the current Lotte Department Store.
The name 'Lotte Shopping Center' was used for a while because the Seoul Metropolitan Government at the time regulated the opening of additional department stores in the city center, and the reason the name returned to Lotte Department Store was because the regulation was lifted around this time.

The surrounding buildings and land, including the previously mentioned former Korea Development Bank headquarters site, the former Hanil Bank headquarters building (currently Avenuel Building), and the former Midopa Department Store headquarters building (currently Young Plaza), were acquired and remodeled, and the buildings were connected by passages, so the overall length is horizontal.
Therefore, it is difficult to include everything in one photo due to the composition, so usually the media only covers the main department store building and Lotte Hotel Seoul.

Avenuel and Young Plaza are separate buildings and are connected to each other by a passage. Because of this, the internal circulation is somewhat unnatural, and some floors have low floor heights.
It used to be the largest department store in Seoul, but is now ranked 4th in size after being overtaken by The Hyundai Seoul, Shinsegae Department Store Gangnam Branch, and Lotte Department Store Jamsil Branch, which was merged with Avenuel. Still, the only consolation is that our Jamsil branch maintains its title as the largest department store in Seoul.

As of 2025, it is the 4th largest department store in the country in sales, and although it is currently in a quite slump compared to its heyday, it is still treated as a core store by Lotte Department Store because it has several records, including ranking first in department store sales nationwide for about 37 years and exceeding 1 trillion won in annual sales for the first time. There are only a couple of large liqueur shops, a tailor shop, a post office delivery machine, a few trophy and medal shops, and a few small raw fish restaurants.

reviews.author: Hong Eui-pyo
reviews.text: Almost nothing inside the shopping mall is open and only 4 restaurants are open.
